evidence.excerpt: Live Arlington online ordering menu at 4021 Campbell Ave was inventoried across every visible weekday category, including starters, entrees, sandwiches, sides, salads/soups, desserts, kids, and NA beverages.
Current Owner-hosted Lunch Menu from the live first-party hub was inventoried completely; direct positive ingredients are retained for exact products.
Current Owner-hosted Dinner Menu from the live first-party hub was inventoried completely; bundled wine was excluded.

Fresh current weekend crawl of the same exact-location online menu exposed the complete brunch service, including starters, omelettes, benedicts, entrees, sandwiches, soup/salad, sides, desserts, NA beverages, and kids brunch.
Current two-page Owner-hosted Brunch Menu from the live first-party hub was inventoried completely. Alcohol was excluded; food and six nonalcoholic cold-brew/tea products were retained.
Current Owner-hosted Happy Hour Menu was inventoried completely for food; alcohol and drink discounts were excluded.
Current image-based Owner-hosted Dessert Menu was rendered and visually inventoried completely. Six desserts were retained and three alcoholic libations excluded.
Current Owner-hosted Kids Lunch + Dinner Menu was inventoried completely.
Current Owner-hosted Kids Brunch Menu was inventoried completely with explicit ingredient positives retained.
Current Owner-hosted Drinks Menu was inventoried completely for nonalcoholic scope: four N/A cocktails, Heineken 0.0, and Athletic Hazy IPA were retained.
Current first-party menu hub links Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, Kids Brunch, Dessert, Drinks, Happy Hour, and Kids Lunch + Dinner menus for the single Arlington location.

Current first-party home page identifies Copperwood Tavern at 4021 Campbell Ave, Arlington, VA 22206, lists active hours and contact details, and offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, reservations, catering, and ordering.

The dietary-restrictions FAQ says the restaurant will make its best attempt to accommodate dietary restrictions and directs guests to call for specific requests; it is not an allergen matrix or safety guarantee.
